<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="Standard">
[Toxic Cloud](/Spells.aspx?ID=1722)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Death" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=40" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=126" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 363

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Apollyon](/Deities.aspx?ID=134), [Nhimbaloth](/Deities.aspx?ID=163), [Ydersius](/Deities.aspx?ID=323)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

**Area** 20-foot burst

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606), except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. A breathing creature that starts its turn in the area takes 6d8 poison damage with a basic Fortitude save. You can Dismiss the spell.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d8.
name: Toxic Cloud
